sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Disability Pension," introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB), Government of Himachal Pradesh, provides a monthly pension of ₹500/- to registered beneficiaries in case of disability caused by accidents or diseases.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Health & Wellness; Sector: Disease and conditions
**Where it applies:** Himachal Pradesh; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The scheme "Disability Pension," introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB), Government of Himachal Pradesh, provides a monthly pension of ₹500/- to registered beneficiaries in case of disability caused by accidents or diseases. Additionally, a lump sum of ₹50,000/- is granted if the disability is more than 50%., and ₹25,000/- is granted if the disability is more than 50%.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - A pension of ₹500/- month. - Additional ₹50,000/- in case the disability is more than 50%. - Additional ₹25,000/- in case the disability is less than 50%.

**Application Process:** **Registration** **Step 1:****** Visit the [official website](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/index.aspx) of the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:****** In the "Menu Ribbon", click "Worker Services > Registration > [New](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/PublicPages/AddBeneficiary.aspx)". **Step 3:****** Navigate to the registration form. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields (marked with an asterisk *). Carefully review all the information provided. Make any necessary corrections. **Step 5:** Click "Save" to submit your application for registration. *The [Registration Status](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/PublicPages/checkstatus.aspx) can be checked by providing your Beneficiary ID and your Date of Birth. **Application** **Step 1:****** Visit the [official website](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/index.aspx) of the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:****** In the "Menu Ribbon", click "Worker Services > [Apply for Benefits](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/PublicPages/ApplyForSchemes.aspx)". On the next screen, provide your Beneficiary ID, and Date Of Birth, and click "Search". A list of schemes will be displayed. Click on the scheme you intend to apply for. You will be taken to the online application form of the scheme. **Step 3:****** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make any necessary corrections. **Step 4:** Finally, click "Submit" to complete the process.

**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** **Registration** **Step 1:** Take the print of the [prescribed format](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/pdf/formno27_A1b.pdf) of the registration form. **Step 2:****** In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:****** Submit the duly filled and signed registration form to the Labour Officer. _* A one-time registration fee must be paid at the office, and it will be valid for three years._ _* After three years, the worker must visit the office to pay a renewal fee and submit proof of 90 days of work each year to maintain eligibility for benefits._ **Application** **Step 1:** Take the print of the [prescribed format](https://bocw.hp.nic.in/pdf/pension3539_A1b.pdf) of the application form. **Step 2:****** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste a passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:****** Submit the duly filled and signed application form to the Labour Officer.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour and Employment Department, Himachal Pradesh
**Tags:** Construction, Building, Labour, Disability, Pension, Worker
